title: Mistral Vibe Provider Attribution & Subagent Runs

questions.prompt: How should Mistral Vibe subagent runs be handled and presented?
questions.description: OpenCode and Hermes Agent recursively merge sub-sessions into the parent session chronologically for holistic analysis. Mistral Vibe currently saves child sessions separately with parent_session_id and agent_type.
questions.recommendedAnswer: Bundle into parent session like OpenCode: merge subagent messages chronologically into the parent session so the conversation view shows the full workflow, while skipping child sessions from cluttering the top-level session list.

options.label: Pure Bundling (like OpenCode/Hermes): Merge subagent messages into parent session chronologically, skipping separate child sessions
Hierarchical Linking: Keep child sessions separate, but add visual badges, parent-child links, and child session tabs in the UI
Both: Bundle messages into the parent session for holistic view, but also support filtering/viewing child sessions

questions.prompt: How should the assistant avatar and name be labeled in the conversation view?
questions.description: Currently, MessageBubble falls back to 'Claude' (purple avatar) whenever sourceTool is mistral-vibe.
questions.recommendedAnswer: Agent-type aware: Display specific agent role (e.g. 'ruby-dev:cleaner' or 'Architect') when an agent_type is present on the session or message, otherwise 'Mistral Vibe' with Mistral branding.

options.label: Agent-type aware: Show agent role (e.g., 'ruby-dev:cleaner') when available, falling back to 'Mistral Vibe' with Mistral branding
Provider only: Always show 'Mistral Vibe' for all assistant messages in vibe sessions

questions.prompt: How should subagent spawn and management tools be rendered in the conversation tool panels?
questions.description: Mistral Vibe uses `agents.spawn`, `subagent.spawn`, `agents.send_message`, etc., and OpenCode uses `task` / `delegate_task`.
questions.recommendedAnswer: Map all subagent tools (agents.spawn, subagent.spawn, task) to AgentToolPanel with parsed agent names, task descriptions, and collapsible inputs/outputs.

options.label: Map to AgentToolPanel: Normalize agent name, task prompt, and description for agents.spawn, subagent.spawn, and task
Leave as GenericToolPanel: Render as raw JSON/arguments without specialized agent badges

questions.prompt: Which additional providers should be added to MessageBubble to prevent defaulting to Claude?
questions.description: Inspect all supported providers to ensure none fall back to Claude unexpectedly.
questions.recommendedAnswer: Include all supported providers currently missing from MessageBubble: antigravity, claude-desktop, and pi.
